questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a non-volatile memory type?
questions.explanation: ROM (Read-Only Memory) retains its data even when power is turned off, making it non-volatile.

questions.question_text: In object-oriented programming, which concept allows a class to inherit properties from another class?
questions.explanation: Inheritance is the mechanism where a new class derives properties and behaviors from an existing base class.

questions.question_text: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for IP addressing and routing?
questions.explanation: The Network layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing and routing packets between networks.

questions.question_text: Which data structure follows the Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: A stack is a LIFO structure where the last item added is the first one to be removed.
SQL is the standard language for managing and manipulating relational databases.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a high-level programming language?
questions.explanation: Python is an interpreted, high-level language, unlike assembly or binary code.

questions.question_text: What is the main function of an Operating System's kernel?
questions.explanation: The kernel is the core of the OS, managing low-level hardware resources like CPU and memory.

questions.question_text: Which of these is a database management system (DBMS)?
questions.explanation: MySQL is a popular open-source relational database management system.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a compiler?
options: To convert high-level code to machine code
questions.explanation: A compiler translates human-readable source code into machine-executable code.

questions.question_text: Which protocol is primarily used for secure web browsing?
questions.explanation: HTTPS adds a layer of encryption (SSL/TLS) to standard HTTP communication.

questions.question_text: What does the CPU stand for?
questions.explanation: The CPU is the primary component of a computer that performs most of the processing inside the computer.
